entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is 77-Alpha-Bravo-21.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up order 77-AB-21... I see it's for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color. It's not what I expected.
I see. And have you used the helmet at all?
No. The box is unopened. It's been sitting here since I got it.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. I'm just checking the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered 31 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy for you.

Alright, I've checked. Since the helmet is a standard VeloFit item and it's unused, it falls within our 90-day return window. We can definitely process that for you. We take safety very seriously, and we'd rather you have a helmet you're completely happy with.
Fine. About time something was simple.

Of course. I've just sent a return label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the package, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, you can expect a full refund within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
